description: This file implements Vulkan backend support for convolution operations, including weight rearrangement, quantization handling, shader selection, and execution of 2D and 1D convolution via Vulkan compute shaders. It defines functions for packing convolution weights and biases, determining convolution methods, and running the convolution in Vulkan context, with support for quantized and transposed convolutions.

classes.name: Conv2dPackedContext
classes.description: Encapsulates packed convolution parameters and shader info for executing Vulkan-based 2D convolutions, supporting quantized, transposed, and various method selections.

classes.description: Provides interface for executing a packed 2D convolution context with support for creation, run, and unpack operations.

classes.name: Conv1dPackedContext
classes.description: Encapsulates packed parameters and shader info for executing Vulkan-based 1D convolutions.
